		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
					scope:bag_wtp_country = { bag_wtp_avail_328 = yes }
				}
				AND = {
					has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end
					scope:bag_wtp_country = { bag_wtp_avail_328 = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cov_try value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material ?= goods:stone } }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cov_try add = 1.0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_cov_try > var:bag_wtp_cov_jewelry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cov_jewelry value = var:bag_wtp_cov_try }
		}
	}
